Event Description: Physician reported elevated deployment force during stent placement in the right carotid artery.
Summary of Investigation Results: Investigation confirmed deployment force measured at 5.51 lbs which exceeds the specification limit of 3 lbs.

Event Description: Patient experienced mild discomfort during procedure; deployment system required additional force.
Summary of Investigation Results: Root cause analysis ongoing; initial bench testing shows force within range on duplicate lot.

Event Description: Stent delivery catheter stuck at lesion site requiring withdrawal and replacement.
Summary of Investigation Results: Investigation found kinked delivery catheter; no product defect identified in stent itself.

Event Description: Deployment force alarm triggered during procedure in cath lab.
Summary of Investigation Results: Lab testing reproduced high deployment force on same lot; corrective action issued to manufacturing.

Event Description: Physician noted difficulty advancing stent through calcified lesion.
Summary of Investigation Results: Investigation pending additional device returns from hospital.

Event Description: Complaint of stent not fully expanding after deployment.
Summary of Investigation Results: Investigation determined user technique issue; device met all specifications upon return.

Event Description: Elevated deployment force reported during emergency carotid intervention.
Summary of Investigation Results: Testing confirmed deployment force of 5.2 lbs on returned unit from complaint lot.

Event Description: Patient had transient leg pain post-procedure; stent patency confirmed on imaging.
Summary of Investigation Results: No device-related cause found; stent deployment force was within specification at 2.5 lbs.

Event Description: Physician reported audible click during deployment with higher than expected resistance.
Summary of Investigation Results: Device returned for analysis; deployment force measurement in progress.

Event Description: Deployment system generated excessive force causing procedure delay.
Summary of Investigation Results: Investigation found contamination on delivery system mandrel; force measured at 4.1 lbs.

Event Description: Stent migrated slightly during deployment requiring repositioning.
Summary of Investigation Results: Migration attributed to lesion morphology; deployment force was 2.9 lbs within spec.

Event Description: Complaint alleges deployment force exceeded labeling limit during routine case.
Summary of Investigation Results: Returned device tested at 5.51 lbs deployment force; matches original complaint VA201301-0455 lot.
